title: paper_v2 reset_audit archive vs source schema divergence — handler must derive reset_type
description: Archive paper_v2_reset_audit has reset_type, reset_reason, snapshot_before_json that source lacks. Live source schema (probed): audit_id bigint, portfolio_id, rerun_policy, start_date, end_date, confirm_text, deleted_counts, status, context, created_at. Round-2 fix removed reset_type CHECK constraint since source has no such column. T14b handler must derive reset_type from (rerun_policy, deleted_counts) and reset_reason from confirm_text/context. Decision needed: keep snapshot_before_json (handler emits empty {} or NULL) vs drop column. Deferred from round-2.

closure_requirements: Decision recorded for snapshot_before_json: keep+empty vs drop
